 is_claimed, profile_tier, review_count, avg_review_rating

test_row_projections_carry_the_reason[
SELECT id, provider_id, name, slug, type, status, town, county, postcode,
 region, local_authority, CASE WHEN rating_state = 'rated' THEN overall_rating END AS overall_rating, CASE WHEN rating_state = 'rated' THEN NULL ELSE rating_state END AS rating_absence_reason, service_types, specialisms,
 number_of_beds, data_completeness_score, data_completeness_tier, latitude, longitude, phone,
 is_claimed, profile_tier, review_count, avg_review_rating,
 ts_rank(to_tsvector('english',
 coalesce(name,'') || ' ' ||
 coalesce(town,'') || ' ' ||
 coalesce(county,'') || ' ' ||
 coalesce(postcode,'') || ' ' ||
 coalesce(local_authority,'') || ' ' ||
 coalesce(address_line1,'') || ' ' ||
 coalesce(service_types,'') || ' ' ||
 coalesce(specialisms,'')), plainto_tsquery('english', coalesce($1, ''))) AS rank
FROM care_providers
]

test_row_projections_carry_the_reason[
SELECT id, provider_id, name, slug, type, status, town, county, postcode,
 region, CASE WHEN rating_state = 'rated' THEN overall_rating END AS overall_rating, CASE WHEN rating_state = 'rated' THEN NULL ELSE rating_state END AS rating_absence_reason, service_types, specialisms, number_of_beds,
 data_completeness_score, data_completeness_tier, latitude, longitude, phone,
 ST_Distance(geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($1, $2), 4326)::geography) / 1000.0 AS distance_km
FROM care_providers
WHERE geom IS NOT NULL
 AND UPPER(status) = 'ACTIVE'
 AND ST_DWithin(geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($1, $2), 4326)::geography, $3 * 1000)
 AND ($4::text IS NULL OR type = $4)
 AND ($5::text IS NULL OR LOWER(BTRIM(CASE WHEN rating_state = 'rated' THEN overall_rating END)) = LOWER(BTRIM($5)))
ORDER BY distance_km ASC
LIMIT $6 OFFSET $7
]
